name: To Hulfdan!
label: Quest
description: To Hulfdan!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Where have you been, friend? Hulfdan's been looking all over the place for you. We thought the king may have put you in irons.
Get to Ironforge as soon as possible and speak with Hulfdan!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Keep yer voice down, friend, the guards may hear ye.
